title: An Evidence-Driven Multi-Agent Compound AI System for Head and Neck Proton Radiotherapy Planning
title_zh: 用于头颈部质子放射治疗规划的证据驱动多智能体复合AI系统

paragraphs.en: Purpose: Radiation treatment planning requires balancing competing objectives to satisfy clinical criteria while accommodating physicians’ preferences. This study aims to develop an evidence-driven, multi-agent compound artificial intelligence (AI) system that integrates deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based automated treatment planning with large language model (LLM)-based conversational plan refinement for proton pencil beam scanning (PBS) therapy.
paragraphs.zh: 目的：放射治疗计划需要在相互竞争的目标之间进行权衡，以满足临床标准并兼顾医生的偏好。 本研究旨在开发一种证据驱动、多智能体复合人工智能（AI）系统，该系统将基于深度强化学习（DRL）的自动化治疗计划与基于大语言模型（LLM）的对话式计划优化相结合，用于质子笔形束扫描（PBS）治疗。

sents.en: This study aims to develop an evidence-driven, multi-agent compound artificial intelligence (AI) system that integrates deep reinforcement learning (DRL)-based automated treatment planning with large language model (LLM)-based conversational plan refinement for proton pencil beam scanning (PBS) therapy.

paragraphs.en: Methods and Materials: In the first stage, a policy network trained using Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) generates multiple treatment plans without human intervention, from which one is selected as the target plan and the others serve as references for subsequent refinements. For challenging cases requiring further adjustments according to physicians’ instructions, an LLM-based multi-agent system enables plan refinement through natural language interactions. The system comprises a planning agent that recommends evidence-supported adjustments, a chatbot providing a unified conversational interface, and an evaluation agent that retrieves clinical metrics and criteria and identifies constraint violations. To enhance domain-specific reasoning and decision-making, the planning agent, based on Qwen3-14B, is designed to justify its recommendations using evidence from previously generated plans and post-trained on task-specific planning data using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). The framework was trained and evaluated using 21 patients with head and neck (H&N) cancers, with five PPO-generated plans per patient. Of these, 50 plans were selected for instruction-guided refinement (42 for model training and eight for testing), with manually constructed adjustment instructions.
paragraphs.zh: 方法与材料：在第一阶段，使用近端策略优化（PPO）训练的策略网络在无人工干预的情况下生成多个治疗计划，从中选择一个作为目标计划，其余作为后续改进的参考。 对于需要根据医生指示进一步调整的疑难病例，基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统可通过自然语言交互实现计划改进。 该系统包含一个推荐循证调整方案的规划智能体、一个提供统一对话界面的聊天机器人，以及一个检索临床指标与标准并识别约束违规情况的评估智能体。 为增强领域特定的推理与决策能力，规划智能体基于 Qwen3-14B，被设计为利用先前生成的计划中的证据来论证其推荐方案，并使用监督微调（SFT）和群体相对策略优化（GRPO）在任务特定的规划数据上进行后训练。 该框架使用 21 名头颈部（H&N）癌症患者进行训练和评估，每名患者生成五个 PPO 计划。 其中，50 个计划被选中用于指令引导的改进（42 个用于模型训练，8 个用于测试），并配有手动构建的调整指令。

paragraphs.en: Results: Compared with the base LLM, the post-trained Qwen3-14B demonstrated improved instruction-following, information retrieval and domain-specific reasoning capabilities. The resulting adjustments more effectively improved user-prioritized objectives while limiting deterioration in competing objectives, yielding more clinically appropriate trade-offs in patient-specific plan refinement. The proposed compound AI system enabled conversational plan refinement through natural language instructions, providing a user-friendly planning platform and reshaping the planning workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：与基础大语言模型相比，经过训练后优化的Qwen3-14B在指令遵循、信息检索和领域特定推理能力方面均有提升。 由此产生的调整能更有效地改善用户优先的目标，同时限制竞争目标的性能下降，在患者个性化计划优化中实现了更符合临床需求的权衡。 所提出的复合人工智能系统可通过自然语言指令实现对话式的计划优化，提供了一个用户友好的计划平台，并重塑了计划制定的工作流程。

paragraphs.en: Conclusions: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first compound AI framework integrating DRL-based automated treatment planning with a domain-specific LLM agent post-trained for instruction-guided plan refinement, offering a promising approach to personalized proton PBS treatment planning. The proposed post-training strategy also provides a solution to reducing trial-and-error adjustment iterations, shortening planning time and lowering token costs for emerging agentic treatment planning systems.

paragraphs.en: Radiotherapy is a conerstone of cancer treatment worldwide, and the quality of a treatment plan can directly influence tumor control, treatment-related toxicity, and ultimately patients’ survival and quality of life. Consequently, treatment planning has received considerable attention from the radiation oncology community. The planning process can be formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem, in which human planners iteratively adjust planning objectives and constraints for target volumes and surrounding organs at risk (OARs) to achieve an appropriate balance among competing clinical goals. This task becomes particularly challenging when OARs are in close proximity to, abut, or overlap with the tumor, making trade-offs between target coverage and normal-tissue sparing unavoidable.
paragraphs.zh: 放射治疗是全球癌症治疗的基石之一，治疗计划的质量可直接影响到肿瘤控制、治疗相关毒性，并最终影响患者的生存和生活质量。 因此，治疗计划受到了放射肿瘤学界的高度关注。 计划过程可以被表述为一个多目标优化问题，其中计划设计者通过迭代调整靶区及周围危及器官（OARs）的计划目标和约束条件，以在相互竞争的临床目标之间取得适当平衡。 当危及器官与肿瘤紧邻、相接或重叠时，这项任务变得尤为具有挑战性，使得在靶区覆盖与正常组织保护之间进行权衡在所难免。

paragraphs.en: In clinical practice, treatment plans often undergo multiple rounds of refinement before final approval, extending the planning process over several days. Such delays are undesirable because patient anatomy may change during this interval, potentially reducing the accuracy of dose delivery in a treatment modality that relies on precise spatial targeting. In addition, plan quality can vary substantially with factors such as planner experience, available planning time, and the capabilities of commercial treatment planning systems (TPSs). Suboptimal trade-offs among competing objectives may compromise either tumor coverage or normal-tissue sparing. Together, these challenges have created a strong need for efficient and reliable methods that can consistently generate high-quality treatment plans, thereby motivating the rapid development of automated treatment planning.
paragraphs.zh: 在临床实践中，治疗方案在最终获得批准前往往需要经历多轮优化，使计划制定过程延长至数天。 这种延迟是不可取的，因为在此期间患者的解剖结构可能发生变化，从而可能降低剂量投照的准确性，而这一治疗方式恰恰依赖于精确的空间靶向。 此外，计划质量可能因计划设计者经验、可用计划时间以及商用治疗计划系统（TPS）的能力等因素而产生显著差异。 在相互冲突的目标之间进行次优权衡，可能会损害肿瘤覆盖或正常组织保护。 总之，这些挑战催生了对高效且可靠方法的强烈需求，以期持续生成高质量的治疗方案，从而推动了自动化治疗计划的快速发展。

paragraphs.en: In last decades, automated treatment planning has been rapidly developed from knowledge-based planning (KBP) [ 1 , 2 ] and multi-criteria optimization (MCO) [ 3 ] to virtual planners built with deep reinforcement learning (DRL) [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 ] and large language models (LLMs) [ 8 , 9 , 10 , 11 , 12 ] . KBP estimates dose-volume histogram (DVH) curve bands from historical data for new patients by mathcing their anatomy to previous cases. MCO generates alternative plans by navigating the trade-off space along the approximate Pareto surface. However, the former collapses three-dimensional anatomy into two-dimensional DVH outputs, resulting in inverse optimization converging to inferior local minima and the necessity of mannual plan adjustments. The latter demands considerable manual effort on base plan generation, Pareto surface exploration and final plan selection [ 12 ] . Both solutions fail to convert the time-consuming and expertise-demand treatment planning into desirable automatic process. Recently, DRL, a powerful approach to decision-making, has been increasingly explored for automated treatment planning. DRL-based methods typically enable policy networks adjustment intelligence through a trial-and-error learning process, using algorithms such as Q-learning [ 4 ] , Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) [ 5 ] , and Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) [ 6 , 7 ] , etc. Although challenges remain in generalizing across diverse treatement sites and formulating reward functions that quantitatively capture the multifactorial assessment of plan quality, these methods have demonstrated promising progress and offer a viable approach to automated treatment planning. Recent years have also witnessed a surge in LLM-based applications in healthcare, particularly in high-stakes clinical decision-making tasks such as open-ended medical diagnostics [ 13 , 14 , 15 ] and multidisciplinary treatment planning [ 16 ] . Among these applications, radiotherapy treatment planning has emerged as an active area of research. For example, Nusrat et al. [ 9 ] proposed the Dose Optimization Language Agent (DOLA) for autonomous prostate radiatherapy planning, integrating chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and reinforcement learning (RL) with Llama 3.1. Liu et al. [ 10 ] developed GPT-RadPlan for volumetric modulated arc therapy (VMAT) planning, leveraging the multimodal model GPT-4V for plan evaluation and objective adjustment through in-context learning.
paragraphs.zh: 近几十年来，自动治疗计划已从基于知识的计划（KBP）[1, 2] 和多准则优化（MCO）[3] 迅速发展为基于深度强化学习（DRL）[4, 5, 6, 7] 和大语言模型（LLMs）[8, 9, 10, 11, 12] 构建的虚拟计划师。 KBP 通过将新患者的解剖结构与既往病例进行匹配，利用历史数据估计剂量-体积直方图（DVH）曲线带。 MCO 通过在近似帕累托面上导航权衡空间来生成备选计划。 然而，前者将三维解剖结构压缩为二维的 DVH 输出，导致逆向优化收敛到较差的局部极小值，并且需要人工调整计划。 后者则需要在基准计划生成、帕累托面探索和最终计划选择方面投入大量人工精力 [12]。 这两种方案都未能将耗时且依赖专业知识的治疗计划过程转化为理想的自动化流程。 近年来，DRL 作为一种强大的决策方法，在自动治疗计划中的应用研究日益增多。 基于 DRL 的方法通常通过试错学习过程使策略网络具备智能调整能力，采用的算法包括 Q-learning [4]、Soft Actor-Critic（SAC）[5] 和 Proximal Policy Optimization（PPO）[6, 7] 等。 尽管在跨多种治疗部位的泛化能力以及构建能够定量刻画计划质量多因素评估的奖励函数方面仍存在挑战，但这些方法已展现出可喜的进展，并为自动治疗计划提供了一条可行的途径。 近年来，基于 LLM 的应用在医疗领域也呈激增之势，尤其是在开放式医学诊断 [13, 14, 15] 和多学科治疗计划 [16] 等高风险临床决策任务中。 在这些应用中，放射治疗计划已成为一个活跃的研究领域。 例如，Nusrat 等人 [9] 提出了用于前列腺放射治疗自主计划的剂量优化语言智能体（DOLA），将思维链（CoT）提示、检索增强生成（RAG）和强化学习（RL）与 Llama 3.1 相结合。Liu 等人 [10] 开发了用于容积旋转调强弧治疗（VMAT）计划的 GPT-RadPlan，利用多模态模型 GPT-4V 通过上下文学习进行计划评估和目标调整。

paragraphs.en: Although DRL and LLMs have significantly pushed the boundaries of automated treatment planning, DRL-based methods lack the flexibility to incorporate human instructions, while LLM-based approaches remain constrained by the limited domain-specific reasoning capabilities of base LLMs. Previous studies have demonstrated that existing LLMs may generate guideline-inconsistent or potentially harmful clinical recommendations [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] . Although their outputs can provide complementary insights and support personalized decision-making, their treatment recommendations in precision oncology have not yet matched the quality and credibility of those made by human experts. Our experiments also indicate that, when given high-level instructions such as “improve [OAR] sparing without compromising [TARGET VOLUME] coverage”, or “reduce hot spots within [TARGET VOLUME] while maintaining its V100% above 92%”, base LLMs often recommend overly aggressive or ineffective adjustments, failing to appropriately balance improvements in the intended clinical objectives against potential deterioration in competing objectives. Moreover, medical LLM agents remain limited in their ability to dynamically adapt to changing patient conditions, further undermining their reliability in generating patient-specific treatment plans. Another limitation is that existing LLM-based agentic planning frameworks primarily focus on automated initial plan generation, overlooking the time-consuming iterative paln refinement guided by physician-planner communication, as illustrated in Figure 1 . This stage is particularly challenging when competing clinical objectives cannot be simultaneously satisfied, and physicians prioritize different objectives when making trade-offs. Furthermore, existing LLM-based automated plannig methods have primarily focused on photon-based radiotherapym such as VMAT and IMRT, while proton therapy planning remains relatively underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管深度强化学习（DRL）和大语言模型（LLM）已显著推动了自动化治疗计划的发展，但基于 DRL 的方法缺乏纳入人类指令的灵活性，而基于 LLM 的方法则受限于基座大语言模型有限的领域特定推理能力。 已有研究表明，现有的大语言模型可能生成与临床指南不一致或具有潜在危害的临床建议 [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] 。 尽管它们的输出可以提供补充性见解并支持个性化决策，但在精准肿瘤学中，其治疗建议在质量和可信度方面尚未达到人类专家所做出的建议水平。 我们的实验还表明，当给出诸如“在不影响 [TARGET VOLUME] 覆盖的情况下改善 [OAR] 保护”或“在保持 [TARGET VOLUME] 的 V100% 高于 92% 的同时减少其中的热点”这样的高层级指令时，基座大语言模型往往推荐过于激进或无效的调整，无法在改善预期临床目标与避免竞争性目标可能出现的恶化之间进行适当权衡。 此外，医疗大语言模型智能体在动态适应患者病情变化方面的能力仍然有限，这进一步削弱了其在生成患者特异性治疗计划方面的可靠性。 另一个局限是，现有基于大语言模型的智能体计划框架主要关注自动化初始计划生成，忽视了如图 1 所示的由医生与计划设计者沟通所引导的耗时的迭代计划优化过程。 当相互竞争的临床目标无法同时满足时，这一阶段尤其具有挑战性，而医生在做出权衡时对目标的优先级排序也各不相同。 此外，现有基于大语言模型的自动化计划方法主要聚焦于基于光子的放射治疗，如 VMAT 和 IMRT，而质子治疗计划仍相对缺乏探索。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose a multi-agent compound AI system for proton pencil beam scanning (PBS) radiotherapy planning. Specifically, a DRL-based policy network is first employed to automatically generate multiple treatment plans without human intervention. Subsequently, a conversational planning platform comprising three agents is developed to enable interactive plan refinement through natural language instructions. In particular, the planning agent is post-trained using SFT and GRPO to recommend patient-specific adjustments supported by evidence derived from previously generated plans, enhancing the reliability and interpretability of its recommendations. Compared with the base LLM, the post-trained model demonstrates improved instruction-following, information retrieval and clinical reasoning capabilities, enabeling more effective plan adjustments aligned with physicians’ preferences while maintaining reasonable trade-offs among competing clinical objectives. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first compound AI framework specifically designed for proton PBS treatment planning that integrates automated initial plan generation with interactive, physician-guided plan refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出了一种用于质子笔形束扫描（PBS）放射治疗计划的多智能体复合AI系统。 具体而言，首先采用基于深度强化学习（DRL）的策略网络，在无需人工干预的情况下自动生成多个治疗方案。 随后，我们开发了一个由三个智能体组成的对话式计划平台，通过自然语言指令实现交互式的方案优化。 其中，规划智能体通过SFT和GRPO进行后训练，以基于先前生成的方案所提供的证据来推荐针对患者的个性化调整，从而提升其推荐结果的可靠性与可解释性。 与基础大语言模型相比，经过后训练的模型在指令遵循、信息检索和临床推理能力方面均有提升，能够进行更有效且符合医生偏好的方案调整，同时在相互竞争的临床目标之间保持合理的权衡。 据我们所知，这是首个专为质子PBS治疗计划设计的复合AI框架，它将自动化的初始方案生成与交互式、医生引导的方案优化相整合。

paragraphs.en: This study was conducted under approval from the institutional review board of University of California San Diego. We retrospectively selected 21 bilateral or ipsilateral H&N cases treated at the California Protons Cancer Therapy Center between 2017 and 2024. Across these cases, treatment courses consisted of 5–60 fractions delivered twice daily, with no more than five beams per plan. Each case contained one to four prescription levels spanning 4.0–74.2 Gy. Rather than redesigning the clinical setup, we retained the original prescriptions, beam angles, target definitions, and field-specific targets from the delivered plans. Moreover, following Wang et al. [ 7 ] , proton spots were arranged on a hexagonal grid and dose was calculated using the Monte Carlo simulation. To ensure machine deliverability, the beam energy constraint of 70-240MeV and the minimal monitor units (MUs) of 3-300MUs per spot are enforced in inverse optimization.
paragraphs.zh: 本研究是在加州大学圣地亚哥分校机构审查委员会的批准下进行的。 我们回顾性选取了2017年至2024年间在加州质子癌症治疗中心接受治疗的21例双侧或同侧头颈部（H&N）病例。 在这些病例中，治疗疗程由每日两次照射的5–60个分次组成，每个计划不超过五个射束。 每个病例包含一到四个处方剂量水平，范围为4.0–74.2 Gy。 我们没有重新设计临床设置，而是保留了已交付计划中的原始处方、射束角度、靶区定义和各射野特异性靶区。 此外，遵循Wang等人 [ 7 ] 的方法，质子斑点以六边形网格排列，剂量采用蒙特卡罗模拟计算。 为确保机器可执行性，在逆向优化中强制施加了70-240MeV的射束能量约束以及每个斑点3-300MUs的最小监视单元（MU）约束。

paragraphs.en: We perform treatment planning with the system depicted in Figure 2 , where an initial planning module built with an adjustment policy network is employed to automatically produce plans for uploaded patient cases without human intervention. The policy network is trained with the PPO framework proposed in Wang’s previous work [ 7 ] . Moreover, the advanced learn-to-optimize (L2O) inverse optimization engine designed in work [ 7 ] is used as the backend of the planning system given its promissing effectiveness and efficiency. For easy cases, the initial planning module is likely to produce clinically accepted plans, while for challenging cases that physicians may give further refine instructions to, an LLM-based multi-agent planning module is designed to adjust a selected plan by reasoning over prior plans generated in the initial planning stage. Since the performance of the PPO-trained policy network and L2O inverse optimizer have been well demonstrated in Wang’s work [ 7 ] , we will focus on the multi-agent planning module, with a foucs on the post-training of the planning agent.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用图 2 中所示的系统进行治疗计划，其中采用基于调整策略网络构建的初始计划模块，在无需人工干预的情况下自动为上传的患者病例生成治疗计划。 该策略网络使用 Wang 此前工作中提出的 PPO 框架 [ 7 ] 进行训练。 此外，考虑到其出色的有效性和效率，工作 [ 7 ] 中设计的先进的学习优化（L2O）逆优化引擎被用作该计划系统的后端。 对于简单病例，初始计划模块很可能产生临床上可接受的治疗计划；而对于医生可能给出进一步细化指令的复杂病例，我们设计了基于大语言模型的多智能体计划模块，通过对初始计划阶段生成的既往计划进行推理来调整选定的计划。 由于 PPO 训练的策略网络和 L2O 逆优化器的性能已在 Wang 的工作 [ 7 ] 中得到充分验证，我们将重点关注多智能体计划模块，尤其是计划智能体的后训练。

sents.en: For easy cases, the initial planning module is likely to produce clinically accepted plans, while for challenging cases that physicians may give further refine instructions to, an LLM-based multi-agent planning module is designed to adjust a selected plan by reasoning over prior plans generated in the initial planning stage.
sents.zh: 对于简单病例，初始计划模块很可能产生临床上可接受的治疗计划；而对于医生可能给出进一步细化指令的复杂病例，我们设计了基于大语言模型的多智能体计划模块，通过对初始计划阶段生成的既往计划进行推理来调整选定的计划。

sents.en: Since the performance of the PPO-trained policy network and L2O inverse optimizer have been well demonstrated in Wang’s work [ 7 ] , we will focus on the multi-agent planning module, with a foucs on the post-training of the planning agent.
sents.zh: 由于 PPO 训练的策略网络和 L2O 逆优化器的性能已在 Wang 的工作 [ 7 ] 中得到充分验证，我们将重点关注多智能体计划模块，尤其是计划智能体的后训练。

paragraphs.en: Physicians have different treatment preferences as they prioritize different objectives, thereby a conversational interface that enables human-in-the-loop planning is crucial. Recent developments in LLM-based agents provide a promising paradigm for facilitating nature language interaction between physicians and automated planning systems. Here, we propose an LLM-based multi-agent planning system as shown in Figure 2 . Specifically, the system consists of three collaborative agents: a chatbot agent, an evaluation agent and a planning agent. The first two agents are prompted GPT models, while the planning agent is a post-trained Qwen3-14B model. Functionally, the chatbot agent serves as the only user interface, responsible for answering general questions on radiation oncology and routing corresponding queries to other agents, e.g., routing high-level plan refine instructions and specific plan adjusting commands to the planner agent, and those relevant to clinical metrics, clinical criteria and constraint violations to the evaluation agent. The evaluation agent is designed to look up clinical requirements, evaluate plan qualities and check constraint violations by retrieving information from the memory module or calling pre-defined APIs. It also compares plans before and after adjustment and provides feedback to the planner agent. The planning agent is post-trained to adjust plans according to user’s queries. For specific adjusting commands like “reset objective parameters to [SPECIFIC VALUES]”, it invokes APIs directly and then confirms with the user. After being confirmed, the inverse optimization agent will be engaged to generate new plans. For high-level instructions like “improve sparing of [OAR NAME]”, the planning agent recommends adjustments and a sequence of API calls that implement proposed adjustments by following a predefined planning workflow. It reasons over the objective-metric mapping of prior plans and justifies its recommendations with reliable evidences.

paragraphs.en: The system is empowered with a memory module and a set of API tools. The memory module stores patient information, clinical criteria and plan’s objective-metric mapping information for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), while the API tools implement operations including DVH metric calculating, objective modifying, plan optimizing, etc for the evaluation and planning agents. As mentioned above, pre-trained LLMs may produce semantically meaningful adjustment recommendations, but the resulting plans may not be clinically acceptable because the simulated dose distributions frequently show unexpected degradations on competing objectives. Therefore, in this work, Qwen3-14B is post-trained on our planning-specific dataset to align its behavior with clinical plan-adjustment practices, thereby reducing the number of adjustment iterations and, consequently, LLM inference costs and overall planning time.
paragraphs.zh: 该系统配备了一个记忆模块和一组 API 工具。 记忆模块存储患者信息、临床准则以及计划的目标-指标映射信息，用于检索增强生成（RAG）；而 API 工具实现 DVH 指标计算、目标修改、计划优化等操作，供评估智能体和规划智能体使用。 如前所述，预训练的大语言模型可能产生语义上合理的调整建议，但由于模拟的剂量分布在相互竞争的目标上经常出现意外的劣化，所得计划在临床上可能并不可接受。 因此，在本工作中，Qwen3-14B 在我们自建的规划专用数据集上进行后训练，以使其行为与临床计划调整实践保持一致，从而减少调整迭代次数，进而降低大语言模型的推理成本和整体规划时间。

paragraphs.en: Moreover, widely used LLM evaluation metrics are not directly applicable to our task because recommended adjustments that appear semantically correct may still be either too aggressive or too conservative to effectively produce a clinically acceptable plan. Instead, the performance of a planning agent should be evaluated based on the final simulation results of the adjusted plan, taking into account both the improvement of the targeted objectives specified in the user’s instruction and the degradation of competing objectives that may not be explicitly mentioned. In addition, a single user instruction may contain conflicting goals that cannot be simultaneously satisfied. Therefore, the reasonableness of the trade-offs among targeted objectives should also be considered in the evaluation.
paragraphs.zh: 此外，广泛使用的大语言模型评估指标并不直接适用于我们的任务，因为看起来在语义上正确的推荐调整，可能仍然过于激进或过于保守，无法有效生成临床可接受的计划。 相反，规划智能体的性能应基于调整后计划的最终仿真结果来评估，同时考虑用户指令中指定的目标对象的改善情况，以及可能未被明确提及的竞争目标的劣化情况。 此外，单条用户指令可能包含无法同时满足的相互冲突的目标。 因此，在评估时还应考虑目标对象之间权衡的合理性。

However, when high-level instructions are given, the planning agent is prompted to follow a planning pipeline as below to recommend justified adjustments:
paragraphs.zh: 当用户提出如“将[OAR NAME]的[OBJECTIVE]限值重置为[VALUE]”之类的具体调整指令时，允许规划智能体直接调用 API 而无需推理。 然而，当给出高层级指令时，会提示规划智能体遵循如下规划流程来推荐合理的调整：

sents.en: When user proposes specific adjusting commands like “reset the limit value of the [OBJECTIVE] for [OAR NAME] to [VALUE]”, the planning agent is allowed to invoke API calls directly without reasoning.
sents.zh: 当用户提出如“将[OAR NAME]的[OBJECTIVE]限值重置为[VALUE]”之类的具体调整指令时，允许规划智能体直接调用 API 而无需推理。

sents.en: However, when high-level instructions are given, the planning agent is prompted to follow a planning pipeline as below to recommend justified adjustments:
sents.zh: 然而，当给出高层级指令时，会提示规划智能体遵循如下规划流程来推荐合理的调整：

paragraphs.en: Retrieve the objectives and corresponding clinical metrics from memory for all target volumes in the current plan;
paragraphs.zh: 从记忆中检索当前计划中所有靶区的目标及相关临床指标；

paragraphs.en: Retrieve the objectives and corresponding clinical metrics from memory for all targeted OARs and critical OARs whose clinical metrics fail to meet or are close to failing the clinical requirements;
paragraphs.zh: 从记忆中检索所有目标危及器官（OAR）以及临床指标未能满足或接近不满足临床要求的重点危及器官（OAR）的目标和相应临床指标；

paragraphs.en: Compare the clinical metrics of the current plan and with those of prior plans, and select a prior plan that better reflects the user’s intended trade-off while causing less degradation in competing objectives as the reference plan;
paragraphs.zh: 比较当前方案与既往方案的临床指标，并选择一个更能体现用户预期权衡、同时对竞争目标造成更少劣化的既往方案作为参考方案；

paragraphs.en: Retrive the objectives and corresponding clinical metrics from memory for all target volumes, all targeted OARs and critical OARs in the selected reference plan;
paragraphs.zh: 从选定参考计划中检索所有目标体积、所有目标危及器官（OAR）及关键危及器官（OAR）的目标和相应临床指标；

paragraphs.en: Recommend adjustments by comparing the objectives and clinical metrics of the current plan and the reference plan to satisfy user’s intent, and suggest API calls that implement above adjustments;
paragraphs.zh: 通过比较当前方案与参考方案的目标和临床指标来推荐调整建议，以满足用户意图，并建议实现上述调整的 API 调用；

paragraphs.en: Output above API calls as the final response and ask the user to confirm proposed API calls.
paragraphs.zh: 将上述 API 调用作为最终回复输出，并请用户确认所提议的 API 调用。

paragraphs.en: The first several steps are placed within a reasoning block enclosed by the “<think>…</think>” tag, and the last output step ensures that any modification to the current plan is confirmed by the user before execution.
paragraphs.zh: 最初几个步骤被放置在由「<think>…</think>」标签包围的推理块中，而最后的输出步骤则确保对当前计划的任何修改在执行前都经过用户确认。

paragraphs.en: We collect training data using manually created queries and ground-truth responses, and post-train the Qwen3-14B thinking model using SFT and GRPO. SFT teaches the model what a good response looks like, while GRPO further optimizes which response is better in a group. Given GPU memory constraints, the widely used parameter-efficient fine-tuning method Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is employed for both training stages. Moreover, the LLM-as-a-judge strategy is used to estimate rewards for the generated responses in GRPO.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用人工构建的查询和标准答案来收集训练数据，并通过 SFT 和 GRPO 对 Qwen3-14B 思维模型进行后训练。 SFT 教会模型什么样的回复是好的，而 GRPO 进一步优化在一组回复中哪一个更好。 受 GPU 显存限制，两个训练阶段均采用了被广泛使用的参数高效微调方法——低秩适配（LoRA）。 此外，在 GRPO 中使用 LLM 作为评判者的策略来估计生成回复的奖励。

paragraphs.en: For each of the 21 cases, we generate five plans using the PPO-trained policy network from the initial planning stage. One plan is designated as the current plan, while the remaining plans are used as prior plans for reference. To improve the robustness of the LLM-based plannig agent by increasing the diversity of the training data, we select up to three different plans as the current plan for each case, and for each selected plan, we manually create one user query as plan-refinement instruction, resulting in a total of 50 training samples (42 for training and 8 for evaluation).
paragraphs.zh: 对于这21个案例中的每一个，我们使用初始规划阶段由PPO训练的策略网络生成五个规划。 其中一个规划被指定为当前规划，其余规划则用作参考的先验规划。 为了通过增加训练数据的多样性来提高基于大语言模型（LLM）的规划智能体的鲁棒性，我们为每个案例最多选择三个不同的规划作为当前规划，并且对于每个选定的规划，我们手动创建一条用户查询作为规划优化指令，最终共得到50个训练样本（42个用于训练，8个用于评估）。

paragraphs.en: For each sample, the ground-truth adjustment is first generated using a GPT model, which is prompted to recommend plan adjustments following the pipeline described above. For a small-scale, domain-specific training dataset, even a few low-quality samples can substantially affect model performance during post-training. paragraphs.en: LLMs acquire substantial knowledge of oncology and treatment planning from large-scale pre-training corpora, and their strong reasoning capabilities enable them to recommend adjustments in generally appropriate directions. However, treatment planning is inherently case-sensitive. For example, both increasing the priority of an OAR objective and decreasing its dose limit value may improve OAR sparing, while different parameter values can lead to substantially different trade-offs with other competing objectives for different cases. Therefore, a key capbility of a planning agent is to determine which adjustment is better for the current case. From our experiments, despite access to prior plans as references, base LLMs may still recommend overly aggressive or ineffective adjustments. To further improve the agent’s ability to distinguish among candidate adjustments and optimize case-specific planning decisions, we continue post-training the planning agent using GRPO [ 22 ] , a reinforcement learning algorithm that optimizes the LLM policy without requiring a separate value model.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型（LLMs）通过大规模预训练语料获得了丰富的肿瘤学与治疗计划知识，其强大的推理能力使其能够给出方向大体合适的调整建议。 然而，治疗计划本质上是对具体病例敏感的。 例如，提高危及器官（OAR）目标函数的优先级和降低其剂量限值都可以改善对OAR的保护，但对于不同的病例，不同的参数取值会与其他相互竞争的目标函数产生差异很大的权衡。 因此，规划智能体的一项关键能力是判断哪种调整更适合当前病例。 从我们的实验来看，即使能够参考既往计划，基础大语言模型仍可能给出过于激进或无效的调整建议。 为了进一步提升智能体在候选调整方案之间进行区分以及优化针对具体病例的规划决策的能力，我们使用GRPO [ 22 ] 继续对规划智能体进行后训练，GRPO是一种无需单独价值模型即可优化大语言模型策略的强化学习算法。

paragraphs.zh: api_evaluator_compute_DMax/DMin/DMean(structureName)：计算指定结构的最大剂量、最小剂量和平均剂量；

paragraphs.en: api_evaluator_compute_Dx/Dcc(structureName, value): computing the Dx and Dcc metrics of a specified structure;
paragraphs.zh: api_evaluator_compute_Dx/Dcc(structureName, value)：计算指定结构的 Dx 和 Dcc 指标；

paragraphs.en: api_evaluator_compute_Vx(structureName, value): computing the Vx metrics for a specified structure.
paragraphs.zh: api_evaluator_compute_Vx(structureName, value)：计算指定结构的 Vx 指标。

paragraphs.en: api_planner_modify_objectives(structureName, metric, limitValue, weight): modifying the constraint or priority of an existing objective for a specified planning structure;
paragraphs.zh: api_planner_modify_objectives(structureName, metric, limitValue, weight)：修改指定规划结构中现有目标的约束条件或优先级；

paragraphs.en: api_planner_inner_optimization(): running inverse optimization to calculate spot MU values and generate a new dose distribution;
paragraphs.zh: api_planner_inner_optimization()：正在运行逆优化以计算点剂量 MU 值并生成新的剂量分布；

paragraphs.en: api_planner_modify_Rx(targetVolumeName, newRx): modifying the prescription dose level of a specified target volume;
paragraphs.zh: api_planner_modify_Rx(targetVolumeName, newRx)：修改指定靶区的处方剂量水平；

paragraphs.en: api_planner_dose_constraint(structureName, lower_dose, upper_dose, metric, weight, limitValue): cropping a subregion receiving dose in between [lower_dose, upper_dose] from an existing structure and constraint its dose by setting an objective on that subregion. This is used to detect the hot or cold areas from the target volumes or OARs;

paragraphs.en: To enable the proposed multi-agent planning system to generate patient-specific responses, a customized JSON-formatted memory is constructed to store treatment-related information, including beam configurations, patient information, clinical criteria, planning structures, prescriptions, and fractionation schemes. In particular, the memory stores objective-metric mappings from prior plans generated during the initial planning stage, which are crucial for the planning agent to infer appropriate adjustments and provide supporting evidence for its recommendations.
paragraphs.zh: 为使所提出的多智能体规划系统能够生成针对患者的响应，构建了一个自定义的 JSON 格式记忆库，用于存储治疗相关信息，包括射束配置、患者信息、临床标准、规划结构、处方以及分次方案。 特别地，该记忆库存储了初始规划阶段生成的既往计划的目标指标映射，这些映射对于规划智能体推断出合适的调整并提供支持其推荐意见的证据至关重要。

paragraphs.en: We qualitatively and quantitatively compare the planning performance of the base Qwen3-14B model and our post-trained Qwen3-14B model. First, we examine the models’ natural-language outputs to assess their instruction-following, information retrieval, and reasoning capabilities. We then introduce a quantitative evaluation method to assess how well the plans adjusted by the base and post-trained Qwen3-14B models satisfy physicians’ requirements, taking into account both improvements in the targeted clinical metrics and degradation in other competing objectives. As our primary goal is to evaluate the performance gains achieved through the proposed post-training strategy, both models are provided with the same prompts and memory to ensure a fair comparison. Finally, we present a conversational treatment planning system implemented using the proposed multi-agent framework to demonstrate how LLMs could reshape treatment planning workflows in the future.
paragraphs.zh: 我们对基础版 Qwen3-14B 模型与我们经过后训练的 Qwen3-14B 模型的规划性能进行了定性和定量比较。 首先，我们检查模型的自然语言输出，以评估其指令遵循、信息检索和推理能力。 然后，我们引入一种定量评估方法，以评估由基础版和后训练的 Qwen3-14B 模型调整后的方案在多大程度上满足医生的要求，同时兼顾目标临床指标的改善与其他相互竞争目标的退化。 由于我们的主要目标是评估所提出的后训练策略带来的性能提升，两个模型被提供相同的提示和记忆，以确保公平比较。 最后，我们展示了一个使用所提出的多智能体框架实现的对话式治疗规划系统，以说明大语言模型未来可能如何重塑治疗规划工作流程。

paragraphs.en: As shown in Figure 3 , although the instruction explicitly prescribes the reasoning procedure and requires API calls to be enclosed in brackets and separated by semicolons, the base Qwen3-14B model does not consistently follow the format, and instead tends to produce responses in a format resembling its pre-training behavior. It also fails to request user confirmation after proposing API calls and frequently omits key information during retrieval, particularly objective settings for planning structures. Information retrieval is especially challenging because each prior plan contains numerous clinical metrics and planning objectives, resulting in a large number of values stored in memory. The base model therefore often retrieves incorrect objective or metric values, which may further lead to hallucinated adjustment rationales. Nevertheless, the base model demonstrates basic treatment planning knowledge. It recognizes that OAR sparing can generally be improved by increasing objective weights and hot spots can be surpassed by adding an additional DMax objective to the hottest subregion. However, its recommendations are often generic rather than adapted to the settings of the current and the reference plans. In Figure 3 , the base model increases the objective weights of all OARs to 2.0 without considering the objective settings of prior plans. The base model can also violate explicit planning constraints. For example, the DMin objective of .CTVhd is limited to 67.32 Gy, and therefore the DMax objective for any of its subregions should exceed 67.32 Gy. This rule is explicitly stated in the instruction. However, the base model introduces a DMax objective with a limit of 66 Gy for a subregion of .CTVhd receiving doses above 66 Gy, thereby creating conflicting objectives.
paragraphs.zh: 如图 3 所示，尽管指令明确规定了推理流程，并要求将 API 调用放入方括号内并以分号分隔，但基础 Qwen3-14B 模型并不能始终遵循该格式，反而倾向于产生类似其预训练行为的回复格式。 它还无法在提出 API 调用后请求用户确认，并且在检索过程中经常遗漏关键信息，尤其是用于规划结构的目标设置。 信息检索尤其具有挑战性，因为每个先前计划都包含大量临床指标和计划目标，导致存储在内存中的数值数量庞大。 因此，基础模型经常检索到错误的目标或指标数值，这可能进一步导致虚构的调整理由。 尽管如此，基础模型仍展现出基本的放疗计划知识。 它认识到，提高目标权重通常可以改善危及器官（OAR）的保护效果，而通过向最热的子区域添加额外的 DMax 目标可以消除热点。 然而，其建议往往是泛泛而谈，而不是针对当前计划与参考计划的设置进行调整。 在图 3 中，基础模型将所有危及器官的目标权重都提高到了 2.0，而没有考虑先前计划的目标设置。 基础模型还可能违反明确的计划约束。 例如，.CTVhd 的 DMin 目标限制为 67.32 Gy，因此其任何子区域的 DMax 目标都应超过 67.32 Gy。 这一规则在指令中有明确说明。 然而，基础模型为 .CTVhd 中接受剂量高于 66 Gy 的一个子区域引入了限制为 66 Gy 的 DMax 目标，从而产生了相互冲突的目标。

paragraphs.en: In contrast, the post-trained Qwen3-14B model follows the instructions substantially better. The think block and API calls are formatted as required, and the model explicitly asks the user to confirm the proposed API calls. It also correctly and completely retrieves the relevant objective and metric values from both the current and reference plans. In particular, the quality of the recommended adjustments improves substantially after post-training. The recommendations are guided by the objective settings of the reference plan, making them more clinically reasonable, while the supporting rationale is also more accurate and reliable. For example, for OpticNerve_L, the base model states: “Current DMax=54Gy (weight=1.0). Reference plan (Nasoph_v1_5) achieves D0.03cc=30.04Gy by increasing weight to 2.0. To improve sparing, increase weight to **2.0** and maintain DMax=54Gy”. However, the actual DMax objective in the reference plan is limited to 26.46 Gy with a weight of 1.0. By contrast, the post-trained model produces a more accurate and adaptive recommendation: “OpticNerve_L sparing in the current plan can be significantly improved by adopting a more aggressive constraint, as used in the reference plan. However, the target coverage in the reference plan is significantly below the clinical requirements, particularly for .CTVhd. Therefore, when applying stricter constraints to OpticNerve_L, a slight adjustment is recommended, rather than a drastic change. **OpticNerve_L**: Increase the DMax weight by 50% to prioritize sparing: 1.0 * 1.5 = 1.5; Decrease the DMax limitValue to a value between 54 and 26.46: 54 * 0.8 + 26.46 * 0.2 = 48.492”.

paragraphs.en: When acting as a planning agent, an LLM should be evaluated based on how effectively its recommendations improve plan quality toward the user’s intent, rather than on the semantic similarity between its natural language outputs and a ground truth response. Therefore, we apply the adjustments recommended by the LLM to the current plan, followed by inverse optimization and Monte Carlo dose calculation to generate the adjusted dose distribution. The LLM can then be evaluated using a quantitative framework that jointly considers: 1) how effectively the resulting plan improves the targeted objectives toward the physician’s intent, and 2) the extent to which these adjustments degrade other conflicting planning objectives. However, these objectives are inherently conflicting, making it difficult to satisfy all requirements simultaneously. The base model achieves only marginal improvements of less than 1 Gy for all four OARs, failing to meet the clinical criteria. Although hot spots within .CTVhd increase, the maximum dose of 111.94% remains below the clinical hard constraint of 115%. Both models improve .CTVhd coverage and suppress hot spots within this target, but achieves only limited improvements in BrainStem and Lens_L sparing. paragraphs.en: To demonstrate how LLMs recommend personalized adjustments for patients with different clinical conditions, we apply the same query for Patient I22 and Patient I23, both with ipsilateral cancer, requesting improved target coverages and reduced hot spots. In the baseline plan of Patient I22, the mean doses to Parotid_L and Glnd_Submand_L substantially exceed their clinical constraints of 26 Gy, while the maximum dose within CTV 66 reaches 129.26% of the prescription dose, indicating severe hot spots. In contrast, Patient I23 exhibits better sparing across all OARs in the baseline plan, with hot spots already within the clinical constraint. For Patient I22, the base Qwen3-14B model improves CTV 66 V 95 % V_{95\%} , V 99 % V_{99\%} , and V 100 % V_{100\%} by 1.6%, 1.8%, and 2.43%, respectively, while reducing its maximum dose to 115.10% of the prescription dose. Despite these substantial improvements, the maximum dose still slightly exceeds the clinical hard constraint of 115%. As a trade-off, the mean doses to Parotid_L and Glnd_Submand_L are increased by 2.23 Gy and 1.29 Gy, respectively, worsening their already excessive doses. In constrast, the post-trained model achieves modest improvements in target coverage, while largely preserving the sparing of other OARs, avoiding further deterioration of critical structures that already violate clinical constraints. It also effectively suppresses hot spots, reducing the maximum dose within CTV 66 to 113.50% of the prescription dose, thereby satisfying the clinical constraint. For Patient I23, however, the post-trained model adopts a more aggressive adjustment strategy, achieving greater improvements in target coverage at the expense of increased doses to other OARs. Nevertheless, the resulting OAR doses remain within their clinical constraints, indicating that the model appropriately exploits the available margins for trade-offs. These results demonstrate that the post-trained model adapts its adjustment strategy to patient-specific clinical conditions. It tends to make conservative trade-offs when competing OAR objectives already violate or approach their clinical limits, but adopts more aggressive adjustments when sufficient margins remain. In contrast, the base model lacks this adaptability. Overall, the post-trained model demonstrates better clinical awareness and more appropriate management of competing objectives, leading to more clinically reasonable and patient-specific treatment plan adjustments.

paragraphs.en: Patient I26 provides another example of how LLMs make different trade-offs when a single query contains requests that cannot be achieved simultaneously. Specifically, the user asks for improving Parotid_L sparing and CTV_6600 coverage. The base Qwen3-14B model achieves modest improvements in both Parotid_L sparing and target coverage at the expense of increased doses to Brain and BrachialPlex_L. In constrast, the post-trained Qwen3-14B model achieves a substantial improvement in Parotid_L sparing, reducing its mean dose from 30.69 Gy to 21.82 Gy, at the cost of slightly compromised target coverage, with CTV_6600 V 99 % V_{99\%} and V 100 % V_{100\%} decreasing by 0.21%, and 0.16%, respectively. This trade-off is clinically worthwhile, as target coverage remains close to the clinical requirement while Parotid_L function can be preserved after adjustment. Treatment planning inherently involves subjective decision-making since physicians may assign different priorities to competing objectives. Both models adjust plan toward user-specified goals without excessively compromising other clinical objectives, potentially reflecting different physician preferences. Therefore, both adjusted plans can be considered clinically reasonable, despite their different trade-off strategies.

paragraphs.en: Overall, the base LLM demonstrates basic treatment planning capabilities, but without domain-specific post-training, it may recommend overly aggressive or ineffective adjustments, and exhibits limited adapbility to patient-specific clinical conditions. When deployed as a planning agent, such a suboptimal LLM may require more iterations to achieve a physician-satisfactory and clinically acceptable plan, resulting in prolonged planning time and higher token costs. Our experimental results demonstrate that the predefined evidence-supported planning pipeline and the proposed post-training strategy effectively enhance the LLM’s planning capabilities, better aligning its behavior with clinical practice and enabling more adaptive, physician-guided plan adjustment.

paragraphs.en: For relatively simple cases, the initial DRL-based automatic planning module can generate clinically acceptable plans with a high success rate without human intervention. paragraphs.en: Rapid advances in LLMs have the potential not only to transform treatment planning workflows but also, more importantly, to improve the quality of generated treatment plans by supporting better planning decisions. To fully realize this potential, developing domain-specific LLMs tailored to treatment planning is crucial. In this work, we post-trained a planning agent for a multi-agent treatment planning framework and demonstrated the effectiveness of the proposed plannig pipeline and post-training stategy in enhancing the LLM’s ability to recommend patient-specific plan adjustments. By enabling users to guide plan refinement through high-level instructions, the proposed planning agent addresses a key limitation of existing automatic treatment planning systems: their limited ability to interact with physicians and refine treatment plans according to clinical preferences in a manner similar to human planners. Moreover, the planning agent can justify its recommendations using evidence derived from the planning objectives and clinical metrics of previously generated plans, improving the interpretability and reliability of the proposed adjustments. By integrating the planning agent with a DRL-based automatic planning module capable of generating high-quality plans without human intervention, the proposed multi-agent framework supports both initial automatic planning and subsequent interactive plan refinement, addressing two essential stages of the clinical treatment plannig workflow.

paragraphs.en: First, prompt-guided planning structure creation is essential for improving system flexibility. In this work, the APIs api_planner_dose_constraint() and api_planner_volume_constraint() enable the planning agent to extract subregions from existing planning structures based on specified dose ranges or highly irradiated volumes. However, users may also need to create auxiliary planning structures before plan optimization through natural language instructions, such as “Subtract the overlapping region between the brainstem and CTV from the brainstem”, or “Create a planning structure encompassing the portion of the brainstem closest to the tumor to facilitate localized dose sparing”. Wang et al [ 6 , 7 ] generated auxiliary planning structures using empirical rules, but more flexible, prompt-guided approaches could provide greater convenience. One possible solution is to develop a set of APIs supporting geometric and Boolean operations on anatomical structures, allowing the planning agent to sequentially execute these operations to generate the desired structures. Alternatively, the framework could be integrated with an advanced prompt-guided medical image segmentation model to enable more flexible structure generation. Second, automatic beam angle selection, an important component of treatment planning, has not been addressed in this work. Ferrante et al [ 11 ] demonstrated the potential of pretrained vision-language models (VLMs), such as GPT-4V, for determining gantry angles in photon radiotherapy. These findings suggest that VLM-based approaches may also be promising for beam angle selection in proton PBS therapy. Incorporating automatic beam angle selection into the proposed framework could further improve planning automation and reduce the need for manual intervention. Third, robust optimization, a critical component of clinically acceptable proton treatment planning, was not incorporated into the current framework. One major challenge is the computational cost associated with repeated Monte Carlo dose calculations. GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo dose calculation offers a promising approach to improving computational efficiency. Therefore, integrating GPU-accelerated Monte Carlo dose calculation and robust optimization into the proposed framework will be an important direction for future research.

paragraphs.en: In this work, we developed a compound AI system integrating DRL-based automated treatment planning with multi-agent conversational plan refinement for proton PBS treatment planning. To enhance the decision-making capabilities of the core planning agent, we proposed a structured planning pipeline and an SFT-GRPO post-training strategy to enable evidence-driven, patient-specific plan adjustments. Experimental results demonstrated that post-training substantially improved the agent’s instruction-following, information retrieval, and clinical reasoning capabilities, enabling more effective adjustments aligned with user intentions while maintaining reasonable trade-offs among competing clinical objectives. This study represents an initial effort to integrate automated initial planning with physician-guided interactive plan refinement for proton PBS treatment planning. Beyond enabling a more flexible and user-friendly planning workflow, our findings highlight the importance of domain-specific post-training in improving the decision-making capabilities of LLM-based planning agents. The proposed framework provides a promising foundation for developing more intelligent, interactive, and clinically adaptable agentic treatment planning systems.
